purpose: Unprivileged, on-demand RK remote debugging helper; no system-wide installation or startup service
origin: Ubuntu noble-updates/universe, downloaded with the existing board apt sources
restore_scope: Only populates the selected application tools directory. Does not register a package or overwrite /usr/bin/gdb or any system library.
transport: gdbserver --once - over existing authenticated SSH stdio, without a listening TCP port
host_debugger: WSL Ubuntu-24.04 gdb-multiarch 15.1; source code and unstripped AArch64 ELF stay on the PC
